name: manual_882a68
claim: Read every field of a rotating secret from one immutable snapshot taken after the refresh, never from two reads of a mutable attribute.

decisions.notes: phylax#20: a concurrent rotate between the id check and the seed read paired the old key id with the new seed; a two-keyring test over one registry is the regression that fails when the refresh is removed.

rationale: phylax#20: a concurrent rotate between the id check and the seed read paired the old key id with the new seed; a two-keyring test over one registry is the regression that fails when the refresh is removed.
